branch reaches hq on the shared link

rows: Next hop from branch to the subnets
referenceTables.title: Design values

scenario: A branch router reaches two small remote subnets on a headquarters router. The upstream router should see one summary instead of the specifics, and the branch needs a default route that exists only while the headquarters path is alive.

checks.description: branch has a static route to 172.16.0.0/24 via hq
branch has a static route to 172.16.1.0/24 via hq

commonMistakes.mistake: Using the wrong next hop, such as the branch's own address or the hq loopback
commonMistakes.recognise: The route is missing or shows a different next hop in the branch route table.
commonMistakes.symptom: Pings fail with no route to host or time out.

commonMistakes.mistake: Configuring only one of the two subnets
commonMistakes.recognise: Only one of the two prefixes is listed as Static on branch.
commonMistakes.symptom: One ping works and the other fails.

doneWhen: The branch route table lists 172.16.0.0/24 and 172.16.1.0/24 as static routes with next hop 10.0.12.2.
The branch router can ping 172.16.0.1 and 172.16.1.1.
explanation: A static route has protocol Static and the next hop is the hq address on the shared link.
hq already has the subnets as connected routes and the link is connected, so replies return without further configuration.
The route table on branch shows preference 5 and next hop 10.0.12.2.
stages.goal: The branch router has no route to the two small subnets that sit behind hq. Give it a fixed route for each, pointing at hq, so it can reach addresses inside them.
stages.hint: Static routes are configured under routing-options; the next hop is the hq address on the shared link.
stages.title: Reach the remote subnets

checks.description: upstream has 172.16.0.0/23 from BGP via hq

commonMistakes.mistake: Creating the aggregate but no export policy
commonMistakes.recognise: hq shows the Aggregate route but upstream does not.

commonMistakes.mistake: Exporting direct routes as well as the aggregate
commonMistakes.recognise: upstream lists 172.16.0.0/24 and 172.16.1.0/24 and the no-specifics baseline check fails.
commonMistakes.symptom: upstream shows the specifics next to the summary.

doneWhen: hq holds 172.16.0.0/23 as an aggregate route.
upstream holds 172.16.0.0/23 learned from BGP with next hop 10.0.23.1.
explanation: An aggregate route is active while at least one more specific route contributes to it; here the two connected subnets do.
On hq it has preference 130 and a reject next hop.
eBGP does not advertise non-BGP routes by default, so an export policy matching protocol aggregate lets the summary through and a final reject keeps the connected specifics out of upstream.
The upstream route table shows BGP with next hop 10.0.23.1.
stages.goal: The upstream router should learn one summary covering both subnets and none of the specifics. Build the summary on hq and make sure only it is passed to upstream over the existing BGP session.
stages.hint: The BGP session sends nothing until it has an export policy. Match the aggregate protocol in that policy and reject everything else.

hq: set policy-options policy-statement export-summary term agg from protocol aggregate
set policy-options policy-statement export-summary term agg from route-filter 172.16.0.0/23 exact
set policy-options policy-statement export-summary term agg then accept
set policy-options policy-statement export-summary term rest then reject
set protocols bgp group upstream export export-summary

stages.title: Summarise for the upstream router

checks.description: branch has a generated default route via hq

commonMistakes.mistake: Configuring a static default route instead of a generated route
commonMistakes.recognise: The route table shows protocol Static for 0.0.0.0/0.
commonMistakes.symptom: The default stays when the contributors disappear.

commonMistakes.recognise: There is no contributing route so the generated route stays inactive.

doneWhen: The branch route table holds 0.0.0.0/0 with protocol Aggregate and next hop 10.0.12.2.
explanation: A generated route is installed only while a contributing route accepted by its policy is active.
Here the contributors are the static routes to 172.16.0.0/24 and 172.16.1.0/24, so the default takes their next hop 10.0.12.2 and shows as Aggregate with preference 130.
If the contributors go away the default disappears with them.
stages.goal: The branch router needs a default route that exists only while a route through hq exists. Create it so that it depends on the branch routes towards the remote subnets and points at hq.
stages.hint: A generated route takes its next hop from a contributing route selected by a policy. The policy must accept the static routes from stage 1 and nothing else.

branch: set policy-options policy-statement default-contributor term hq-nets from protocol static
set policy-options policy-statement default-contributor term hq-nets from route-filter 172.16.0.0/23 longer
set policy-options policy-statement default-contributor term hq-nets then accept
set policy-options policy-statement default-contributor term rest then reject
set routing-options generate route 0.0.0.0/0 policy default-contributor

stages.title: Make a conditional default

branch: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.12.1/30
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.255.1/32
hq: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.12.2/30
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.23.1/30
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.255.2/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 172.16.0.1/24
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 172.16.1.1/24
set protocols bgp group upstream type external
set protocols bgp group upstream peer-as 65003
set protocols bgp group upstream neighbor 10.0.23.2
upstream: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.23.2/30
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.255.3/32
set protocols bgp group hq type external
set protocols bgp group hq peer-as 65002
set protocols bgp group hq neighbor 10.0.23.1

startState.description: Branch, hq and upstream are addressed and each has only connected routes. hq owns 172.16.0.0/24 and 172.16.1.0/24 on lo0. An eBGP session (AS 65002 hq to AS 65003 upstream) is established between hq 10.0.23.1 and upstream 10.0.23.2 and carries no routes yet.

summary: Finish the routing on a three-router line so the tables show static, aggregate and generated routes.
title: Summarise a branch's routes with static, aggregate and generated routes

nodes.role: Branch router that needs the remote subnets and a conditional default
